steps.name: desktop-repo-and-github-audit
steps.command: set -eu; REPO="$HOME/Desktop/tracker"; if [ ! -d "$REPO/.git" ]; then REPO="$HOME/Pulpit/tracker"; fi; echo REPO=$REPO; test -d "$REPO/.git"; cd "$REPO"; echo '=== LOCAL ==='; pwd; git status --short --branch; git remote -v; echo '=== GH AUTH ==='; gh auth status; echo '=== MAIN ==='; git fetch --prune --tags origin; git rev-parse origin/main; echo '=== BRANCHES ==='; git branch -a -vv; echo '=== TAGS ==='; git tag --sort=-creatordate; echo '=== OPEN PRS ==='; gh pr list --state open --limit 50; echo '=== PROTECTION ==='; gh api repos/MichalMatu/tracker/branches/main/protection || true; echo '=== RULESETS ==='; gh api repos/MichalMatu/tracker/rulesets || true; echo '=== CHECK RUNS GUIDE ==='; gh api repos/MichalMatu/tracker/commits/9d94f0f76dfb51373efeae48e31ea696f55eef83/check-runs --jq '.check_runs[] | [.name,.status,.conclusion] | @tsv' || true; echo '=== DOCS ==='; find . -maxdepth 2 -type f \( -name '*.md' -o -name 'AGENTS.md' \) | sort; echo '=== RECENT HISTORY ==='; git log --oneline --decorate --graph --all -n 40; echo '=== DIRECT PUSH DRY FACTS ==='; gh repo view MichalMatu/tracker --json defaultBranchRef,viewerPermission,isPrivate,nameWithOwner
